facts.fact: ANGOP reports the commune administration offices of Mulondo, plus its health and education directorates, got internet for the first time on 13 June 2024 through a satellite operator paid for by the Matala municipal administration.
The commune's public servants use the connection to send and receive correspondence and information, instead of travelling over 100 km.
Only one commune, Mulondo under Matala municipality, is reported connected; the administrator says it still needs Angosat-2 through Conecta Angola.
